It has it ALL - five stunning pools, an award winning spa with a rooftop pool, championship 18-hole golf and multiple top-tier restaurants. 

I’ve visited here for the restaurants alone: 
🍳 Mowry & Cotton (brunch fave)
⛳️ The Tavern (casual with dueling pianos)
🫖 Afternoon Tea (they refill your sandwiches!)
🥩 J&G Steakhouse (wine & sunset views)

If you’re ready for a summer reset, Book your stay now and thank me later. 😉 Thank you to The Phoenician for having me. 

The Phoenician 
📍6000 E Camelback Rd, Scottsdale, AZ 85251

findings.title: letthemeatthis
findings.snippet:
The best way to stay cool this summer is at the Phoenician 🍹

Phoenician Resort is a beautiful 5-star resort located in Scottsdale, Arizona. They are kicking off summer with great deals all season long for their Legendary Summer celebration. Before the Phoenician, Jokake Inn welcomed visitors to Phoenix in 1926, where they sold tea and cakes. You pass Jokake Inn on the property as you make your way up to the resort. So stop to take some iconic pictures before check-in!

I stayed in a King Suite, which had a tub and a cozy patio. They have some special rates they are offering this summer such as their spa, golfing, and summer menus. The perfect way to celebrate Independence Day is by hanging out at one of their many pools. They offer a splash pad for the kids, a water slide, and an adults-only pool. You can rent cabanas and they offer poolside eats and drinks. If the pool isn't your vibe, they have yoga, a spa, pickleball, golf, and more.

For restaurants, you have a ton of choices to choose from. Mowry and Cotton do lunch, brunch, and dinner. Their brunch was my fav! Get the tacos and their French toast! If you like more of a sports bar vibe, the Tavern at the 19th hole is your jam. They do boozy milkshakes, burgers, and smores! Don't forget about dueling pianos either. The best date night spot is at J&G Steakhouse. Perfect spot to catch the sunset and they offer great cuts of steak. They have a special summer menu right now. 

They offer high tea on the weekends as well. Definitely make a reservation in advance so you can enjoy tea and sandwiches. 

Read their summer offerings here:
https://www.thephoenician.com/events/legendary-summers/

📍6000 E Camelback Rd, Scottsdale, AZ 85251

#staycation #hotel #Scottsdaleaz #summer #vacation

✨Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician

Not only is The Phoenician Arizona’s finest AAA Four Diamond resort but it hosts the most luxurious afternoon tea experience in Scottsdale. Guests can enjoy finger sandwiches, scones with clotted cream and preserves, pastries, and a selection of fine tea blends.

It is consistently voted “Best afternoon tea” by the Phoenix New Times and for good reason! Reservations are required (and get snapped up fast!) if you’re looking to book this experience for yourself, seatings are between 2pm-3pm only from Wednesday-Sunday.

The Phoenician is a luxury resort that has everything you need! The Arizona weather is gorgeous, and the rooms are nice and clean. There are three restaurants on site: a casual dinner spot, a high-end steakhouse, and an elevated brunch option. Plus, there's a marketplace with amazing sandwiches.

findings.title: the.trip.rater
findings.snippet:
Signature Dish to Try 🍽️
The 48-Hour Short Rib at J&G Steakhouse, slow-cooked to perfection and served with silky mashed potatoes and a red wine reduction—pure indulgence with unbeatable Camelback Mountain views.

Most Unique Feature 🏜️
The Cactus Garden, a two-acre botanical retreat showcasing 250+ species of cacti and succulents, winding trails, and breathtaking desert sunsets. A serene, must-see oasis in the heart of the resort.

Best Cocktail or Drink Experience 🍹
The Prickly Pear Margarita at Thirsty Camel Lounge, blending tequila, prickly pear purée, and citrus, creating the ultimate vibrant desert-inspired sip with spectacular golden hour views.

Can’t-Miss Activity or Experience 💆
Relax and rejuvenate at the Phoenician Spa, featuring a meditative desert-inspired atmosphere, luxurious treatments like the desert rose body wrap, and a signature cactus flower facial that will leave you feeling refreshed and glowing.

Most Luxurious Room or Suite 🏡
The Presidential Suite, a 5,000+ sq. ft. sanctuary featuring panoramic balcony views, a private fitness area, a baby grand piano, and a dining room for 10—the pinnacle of Sonoran Desert luxury.
